about: Test vectors for the libzync chain-proof verifier (swiftsync-verify, its C ABI and WASM). Each case gives the verifier arguments (swiftsync-verify syntax) and the exit code a correct verifier must give: 0 OK, 2 DEMO, 1 FAIL. The mainnet_1_200_8888d59c receipts are a real GPU proof of mainnet 1..200 under the frozen product image 8888d59c (risc0 3.1.0). The r4_* receipts are from the retired round-4 design-B signet image c3501ac900743bbc911c8f6dedcd71f1ee53fe4bea4f1cbc9726324478e63dae: every one must FAIL (the journal format and the hints file are both gone). `cli_only` cases test the CLI's argument handling and are skipped by the C and WASM harnesses.

cases.name: retired_design_b
cases.description: A real round-4 design-B receipt, given as a coin-log image: refused (its journal is not today's ChainState, and its image keeps no coin log).

cases.name: retired_design_b_product
cases.description: The same receipt as the product image: refused.

cases.name: wrong_image
cases.description: The same receipt against the built-in image id: refused.

cases.name: fake_receipt
cases.description: A dev-mode FakeReceipt: never a proof.

cases.name: bundle_v1
cases.description: A version-1 bundle (it carried a hints-file hash): refused.

cases.name: bundle_header_lies
cases.description: A bundle whose header disagrees with its receipt: refused.

cases.name: mainnet_1_200_demo
cases.description: A real GPU proof of mainnet blocks 1..200 under the frozen product image 8888d59c (risc0 3.1.0): valid, but below Core's minimum chainwork, so DEMO.

cases.name: mainnet_1_200_as_signet
cases.description: The same receipt checked as signet: refused (another network's image and genesis).

cases.name: mainnet_1_200_old_image
cases.description: The same receipt against 863c9ce3, the same guest built on risc0 3.0.5: refused (the image id commits to the toolchain).

cases.name: mainnet_1_200_flipped
cases.description: The same receipt with one bit flipped at byte 5000 (inside the seal): refused.

cases.name: hints_arg_refused
cases.description: A hints-file argument (the retired design B): the CLI refuses it rather than ignore it.

cases.name: dash_arg_refused
cases.description: The old '-' (no hints file) argument: refused.

status: Hints-file cases removed in E2 (11-05: no proof takes a hints file). OK / DEMO cases need receipts of the product image: regenerate from the first GPU proofs of the frozen image (experimental/libzync-bench/gpu/COINLOG_GPU_PLAN.md).
